import sys

def count_even_runs(s, i, start):
    if i == len(s):
        return 1 if (i - start) % 2 == 0 else 0
    if s[i] != s[start]:
        add = 1 if (i - start) % 2 == 0 else 0
        return add + count_even_runs(s, i, i)
    return count_even_runs(s, i + 1, start)

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    if not s:
        print(0)
        return
    print(count_even_runs(s, 1, 0))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
